messages:
nora: Quick heads-up 8/retreat release					we just cut community-infra-kit v0.9.0				https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-infra-kit/releases/tag/v0.9.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: community-infra-kit v0.9.0 by @nora https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-infra-kit/releases/tag/v0.9.0 (auto)
pat: Love it. What's new in this one?
nora: Short list: new local dev profile (lighter docker-compose), improved maintainer onboarding docs, a maintenance checklist action, and a tiny breaking rename in env file keys.
pat: Which env keys changed? Any automated migration?
nora: OLD: COMMUNITY_ADMIN, GRANT_BUCKET. NEW: COMMUNITY_ADMINS (plural) and GRANTS_S3_BUCKET. We provided a small migrate script in tools/ (bash) and the helm values still accept the old names for two releases with a deprecation log.
pat: Nice. Can you paste the migrate snippet?
nora: Sure:
```bash
# tools/migrate-env.sh
set -e
cp .env .env.bak
sed -E 's/^COMMUNITY_ADMIN=/COMMUNITY_ADMINS=/; s/^GRANT_BUCKET=/GRANTS_S3_BUCKET=/' .env.bak > .env
echo "migrated .env -> .env (backup at .env.bak)"
```
alex: For private deployments: any DB schema bumps?
nora: No schema changes. We added a lightweight cron job for housekeeping (stale-invitations cleanup) but it's opt-in in the helm chart. Check release notes for the toggle.
devrel: Planning a short livestream walkthrough tomorrow 11am PT for maintainers to walk new onboarding flow + checklist. I'll post the calendar and a 5-min demo clip.
ci-bot: New issue created: #87 "add e2e test for onboarding checklist" by @pat https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-infra-kit/issues/87
pat: I'll take that issue this sprint. Also will open a PR to add a lint that flags use of old env keys.
ci-bot: PR opened: #88 "lint: warn on legacy env keys" by @pat 
nora: Tagging maintainers for visibility @alex @pat @devrel. Soft announce to community channel now; newsletter blurb goes out tonight. Thanks to everyone who iterated on the onboarding docs at the retreat.
alex: Congrats team great iteration.
nora: If folks hit issues migrating, ping #devex and we'll triage. :rocket:
